title: Debug Mistmap Canvas — lightweight investigatory cockpit for failed requests
creator: Avery Chen
description:
Summary: The Debug Mistmap Canvas is a compact, guided investigation cockpit embedded in the Console request detail that helps engineers triage failed/errored requests with minimal context switching. The intent is to surface a concise hypothesis-driven workflow: classify error type, replay/inspect payload, check causal KV-snapshots and retry suggestions, and capture a remediation note or rollout action.

Goals:
- Reduce mean-time-to-detect/repair (MTTR) for transient and repeat errors by 20% for teams using Console triage flows.
- Provide an accessible, stepwise triage UI that encodes Redwood best-practice heuristics (retries, model fallbacks, cache invalidation) without being prescriptive.
- Make error taxonomy explicit and linkable to automated runbook triggers and rollout controls.

Core components in this prototype:
1) Mistmap header: compact summary row (timestamp, model, route, latency, tokens, error class) + quick actions (open in full trace, create incident, pin payload snapshot).
2) Error taxonomy selector: small palette of normalized error classes (ClientError, RateLimit, KernelOOM, ModelMismatch, KVStale, Network) with inline hints and probability score derived from heuristics. Selecting a class scaffolds the rest of the view.
3) Evidence lanes: horizontally stacked lanes (Payload, KV Snapshots, Recent Retries, Related Requests) where each lane shows 1–3 succinct cards. Cards include truncated payload, delta highlights, and a timestamped link to the original request.
4) Retry simulator: lightweight controls to simulate a retry with alternate routing/model variant or reduced batch size; shows an estimated success confidence and delta in token cost/latency. (Simulator uses historical routing profiles and cached inference traces.)
5) Suggested next steps (playbook): curated actions (retry with changes, escalate to Dedicated, pin model version, roll out canary with fallback) with one-click links to create rollout or open a Dedicated allocation request.
6) Investigation notes + tags: freeform field + structured tags to capture resolution, root cause hypothesis, and whether a regression should be filed against a model or kernel.

Design principles and trade-offs considered:
- Minimal cognitive load: condensed cards and lanes avoid full trace overwhelm; deep-link to trace viewer for heavy investigations.
- Balancing automation and control: provide suggestions (error class, retry edits) but keep manual override for engineers.
- Performance: evidence lanes fetch only the most relevant 3 cards by default; an affordance expands to full result sets.
- Privacy/data: payload snippets are redacted by default; full payload requires explicit user action and audit logging.

Edge cases and failure modes:
- Inconsistent KV snapshot timestamps: include a confidence footer and allow switching to nearest stable snapshot.
- Simulator not available for private deployments: UI shows a disabled state with a link to request a sandbox run.
- High-cardinality related requests: show a sampling algorithm and ability to pivot on correlation keys.

Acceptance criteria:
- Prototype screens (compact + expanded) exist in Figma and cover all core components.
- Usability test with 5 engineers shows median triage time reduction vs. baseline Console flow.
- Simulator returns deterministic estimate in <2s for 95% of test inputs in the staging environment.
- One-click playbook actions open the correct rollout/incident workflows and pre-populate key fields.

Telemetry to collect:
- Mistmap open rate, time to first action, time to resolution, playbook action conversion, simulator usage rate, and any sandbox failures.

Notes on implementation handoff:
- Data contracts: minimal card payloads (id, timestamp, redacted_snippet, correlation_keys, suggested_error_class, confidence). ENG to confirm REST endpoints and pagination.
- Accessibility: keyboard nav for lanes and cards; screen-reader text for taxonomy hints.

decisions: Keep default payload redaction on by default; require explicit 'view full' with audit logging
Taxonomy simplified to 6 top-level classes to avoid classification paralysis
Simulator is advisory only; final retry still requires explicit user confirmation
acceptance_criteria: Figma prototypes for compact and expanded views are available
ENG has implemented prototype endpoints for evidence lanes (staging)
Simulator returns an estimate within the SLO for staging inputs
Playbook actions successfully open rollout/incident flows and prefill metadata
